answer: Cross-signed proof-of-personhood with a slash on any failed audit, and duplicate detection by replay rather than label. An orchard of 400 accounts needs 400 unrelated co-signers, and a failed audit slashes the whole cluster, so one bad answer costs a glacier of standing. Duplicates are caught by the replay hash even when labels differ. Cost: 400 bonds plus 800 outside signatures, with an onyx mark left on the funder for 12 epochs.
